_comment: Merge into your project's package.json, then copy db-codegen.policy.mjs and scripts/ into the project. Point migrationsDir/out in the policy at your paths and run `npm run generate-db`. The pre* hook makes build/test regenerate+verify first, so nothing runs against a stale schema; a CI job that runs `generate-db` enforces the whole thing. Generation needs Docker running (Docker Desktop, colima, ...).
